rationale: The candidate reads as a single nested bar system wrapped around a central carved void, so the overall gesture is legible across views. The front and isometric show a usable main/support relationship, but the mass still feels somewhat thin and segmented, with some secondary pieces competing with the dominant bar. The silhouette depends partly on stepped/shifted edges rather than a fully continuous volumetric idea, which weakens the non-stair reading. The void is present but not especially public or enlarged; it feels more like an internal atrium cut than a strong ground-level civic opening. Repair integrity is relatively strong because the geometry stays mostly connected and consistent in plan, without obvious view-to-view collisions. Precedent resonance is moderate: it echoes stacked/shifted platform and carved-atrium precedents, but without the clarity or force of the references.
warnings: The void reads more internal than public-facing.
Several bars feel too close in thickness, reducing hierarchy.
The mass could become cleaner if one anchor volume is made dominant and minor offsets are reduced.
